_doc: Seasonal place gates. Keyed by place slug; months are 1-indexed (Jan=1, Dec=12). A place listed here is HIDDEN from public listings whenever the current month is NOT in its months array. /places/<slug> still resolves (so shared links + sitemap entries don't 404), but the place won't appear in /map, /places, /m/<muni>, search, etc. Add entries here when a place is genuinely seasonal — not for places that just have winter hours.
